contexts.text: Wandering stars around a Spirit signify falsities. AC 1128.
Under Drunk, see this reference. AC 1072.
He saw the nakedness of his father = that he observed his errors and perverted things... They who are in faith separated from charity see nothing else...
With those who are in no charity... there is a publication of errors whenever there is an opportunity.
They went backwards = that they did not attend to the errors and perverted things.
Their faces were backwards, and they saw not the nakedness of their father = that so it ought to be done, and that no attention should be paid to such things as errors and mistakes from reasonings.
Noah awoke from his wine = ... that he came out of the errors.

When a man feels that he has compassion... especially for one who is in error as to the doctrine of faith, he may know that he dwells in the tents of Shem, that is, that he possesses internal things through which the Lord is operating.
These are called wandering Souls or Spirits...

She went and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba () = an erratic state in the doctrinal things of faith... In this verse is described the quality of the state at first with those who are being reformed; to wit, that they are carried away into various errors... The things, however, which enter at that time, although for the most part erroneous, are still such things as serve to promote growth...
Of those who are in ignorance of good, it is predicated that they wandered in the wilderness ().
He thus casts himself into grievous errors.
Lo, he was wandering in the field () = that they had fallen from the general truth of the Church.
Perchance this was an error () = lest he be adverse. An error = what is adverse. Explained.
Sin = disjunction and turning away; and so does an error if there is sin in it, but in a less degree.
Hence it is evident how easily they may fall into error...
To behold a mote in a brother's eye = something erroneous as to the understanding of truth.
See Enemy.
In going, they wander...
Hence come errors, one after the other...
These little stars appear... wandering with those who are in truths falsified.
What is erroneous cannot be seen before.
This is the fundamental error of the Church.
An erratic or wandering faith, which is a faith in a number of gods.
On a wicked crew, wandering through Heaven.
Then certain... erroneous things crept in... Therefore, the mistakes and errors, even the least of them, were from them.
That in the other life, Souls are at first as it were wandering.
To do hypocrisy and to speak error () = to do evil from falsity, and to speak falsity from evil.

They err through wine, and wander away through strong drink () = through falsities, and through those things which are from them... They err among them that see () = that they do not see the truths which are of intelligence.
The falsities which he speaks against truths, are meant by the error which he speaks against Jehovah ().
The wandering sheep () = him who is not in the good of love and of charity, because, from ignorance, he is in falsities; for where there is falsity there is not good, since good is of truth.
The origins of all the errors in the Church have been, that they believed man to live from himself...
